summary: Iteration 43 — Spellcheck visibility audit. Frontend-only testing. Verified Campaign editor + Drip campaign step composer both render the RichTextEditor with spellcheck='true', lang='en', autocorrect='on'. The new toolbar indicator-button `editor-verify-spellcheck-btn` is visible (with pulsing emerald dot + text 'Spellcheck: Active · Verify') in both editors. Clicking it in Visual mode inserts the misspelt word 'definately' into the contentEditable; clicking it in HTML mode appends ' definately ' to the HTML textarea. The HTML textarea has spellcheck='true', lang='en', autocorrect='on'. The <style> block contains the required ::spelling-error rule with 'red wavy underline' and 'text-decoration-skip-ink: none'. Plain-text fallback textarea attributes verified by static review of RichTextEditor.jsx (L1003+). AdminBlogs.jsx + DripCampaignView.jsx + Campaign.jsx all import the same RichTextEditor component (static-grep confirmed). No new console errors observed. Backend smoke-test SKIPPED per instructions (frontend-only).
critical_code_review_comments: RichTextEditor.jsx is 1056 lines — already past the 700-line soft cap. Consider splitting toolbar / image-resize / link-popover / HTML-mode logic into sub-modules in a future iteration (not blocking).
Pre-existing lint blockers (L520/645/658/663/991 per main agent's note) remain — not introduced in iter-43, but worth tracking.

The Spellcheck Verify button uses document.execCommand('insertText', ...) — execCommand is deprecated. Current fallback (createTextNode appendChild) works, but consider moving to Selection/Range API in a follow-up iteration.
